_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: sentiment at 62, neutral funding, weak 30d momentum — no breaker visible for Hope or Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: both cautionary (analyst HOLD/CAUTION coil; narrative mild distribution) but narrative does not explicitly call phase/direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-62 and BTC stays in low-single-digit 30d drift with funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed >63 with expanding 30d momentum (up into Hope), or fast de-risk drops F&G under 55 with funding negative (down into Complacency)
